Simulation study - model 1

In this file a simulation study is conducted. The predicted values per method (ols - ridge regression -local shrinkage) are computed per simulated data set. The predicted values are then compared with the true values , known by design.
```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(tidyr)
getHdata(gusto)
gusto.dat <- gusto

set.seed(4176340)

gusto.dat <- gusto[which(gusto$grpl %in% c(1,2,4) & gusto$grps %in% c(5,9,10,11)),] 
n_pat <- nrow(gusto.dat)  
gusto.dat$pat.id <- 1:n_pat

#variables considered:
gusto.dat$HEI <- gusto.dat$height
gusto.dat$WEI <- gusto.dat$weight
gusto.dat$AGE <- gusto.dat$age
gusto.dat$SYS <- gusto.dat$sysbp
gusto.dat$PUL <- gusto.dat$pulse


```

Function for local shrinkage:

1- Cross validation function to find the optimal threshold:
```{r}

Cross_val_local_shrik <- function(neff, newdata,fold_k) { 
  
  mse <- rep(0,5)
  
  for(i in 1:5){ #folds
    train <- newdata[fold_k != i, ] 
    test  <- newdata[fold_k == i, ]
  
    form1 <- y_sim ~ HEI + AGE + PUL + SYS
    
    mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = train)
    
    X_ols <- model.matrix( ~ HEI + AGE + PUL+ SYS, data= train)  
    XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols
    
    relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols)) #compute 1/effective sample size for each subject in the model
     for(j in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
      relvar_OLS[j] <- (t(X_ols[j,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[j,])}
    
    #initialization 
    
    Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] 
    n          <- nrow(Z_ols) 
    Z_shrink   <- Z_ols    
    relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS 
    z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) 
    zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
    
    X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink) 
    iter       <- 0 
    maxiter    <- 1000
    dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
    diststart  <- dist  
    max_dist <- n*1/neff-1 
    
  
 
    Cov <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) 
    
    while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){ #while loop until all distances are below the threshold
  
  ## compute the shrinked distance
      distshrink  <- dist
      distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist 
  
  # compute shrinkage factor
      a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist)
  
  
      azc         <- a*zc #shrink of the centered covariates
      Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) #adding the mean back
  
      iter <- iter + 1  

      X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)  #adding the intercept to the shrunk predictors
   
      z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) #computing the mean
  
      zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) #re-center 
  
      Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) #recompute the shrunk XTX
  
      relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink))  
  
      n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it #recompute the effective sample sizes
  
      dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  #recompute the distance
      }


  train_shrunk <- data.frame("y_sim" = train$y_sim) #response variable
  train_shrunk <- cbind(train_shrunk, Z_shrink)
  mod_train_shrink <- lm(formula = form1, data = train_shrunk )
  
  #per each test:
  X_ols_test <- model.matrix(~ HEI + AGE + PUL + SYS, data= test) 
  
  relvar_OLS_test <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_test))  
  
  for(k in 1:length(relvar_OLS_test)){
    relvar_OLS_test[k] <- (t(X_ols_test[k,])%*%Cov%*%X_ols_test[k,])}
  
  n.test <- nrow(X_ols_test)
  test_distance <- n*relvar_OLS_test-1 #test set distances
  
  # shrink test set 
  distshrink_test <- pmin(test_distance, max_dist)
  a_test <-  sqrt(distshrink_test / test_distance) #shrinkage factor test set
  
  Z_ols_test   <- X_ols_test[,-1]
  
  Z_shrink_test <- Z_ols_test 
  
  relvar_it_test <- relvar_OLS_test

  zc_test        <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) #center the covariates of the test set
  azc_test <-zc_test*a_test #shrinking the new patient covariates 
  Z_shrink_test    <- t(apply(X=azc_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) #re-adding the mean 
  X_shrink_test <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n.test), Z_shrink_test) 
  
  #compute MSE:
  
  test_shrunk <- data.frame("y_sim" = test$y_sim) 
  test_shrunk <- cbind(test_shrunk, Z_shrink_test)
  pred <- predict(mod_train_shrink, newdata = test_shrunk)

  
  mse[i] <-  mean((test$y_sim- pred)^2)} #MSE

  mse_i <- mean(mse) #mean MSE
  
  return(mse_i)
}





```

2- local shrinkage function to compute predictions:
```{r}
local_shrik <- function(neff, newdata) { 
  
  
  #inizialization, same steps as above
    form1 <- y_sim ~ HEI + AGE + PUL + SYS
    
    mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = newdata)
    
    X_ols <- model.matrix( ~ HEI + AGE + PUL+ SYS, data= newdata)  
    XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols
    
    relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols)) 
     for(j in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
      relvar_OLS[j] <- (t(X_ols[j,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[j,])}
    
    Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] 
    n          <- nrow(Z_ols) 
    Z_shrink   <- Z_ols    
    relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS 
    z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) 
    zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
    
    X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink) 
    iter       <- 0 
    maxiter    <- 1000
    dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
    diststart  <- dist  
    max_dist <- n*1/neff-1 
    
  
    Cov <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) 
    
    while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){ 
      distshrink  <- dist
      distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist 
  

      a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist)
  
  
      azc         <- a*zc
      Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) 
      iter <- iter + 1  
 
      X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink)  
   
      z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink) 
  
      zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
  
      Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) 
  
      relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink)) 
  
      n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it 
  
      dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
      }

  #compute predictions
  newdata_shrunk <- data.frame("y_sim" = newdata$y_sim) 
  newdata_shrunk <- cbind(newdata_shrunk, Z_shrink)
  
  mod_newdata_shrink <- lm(formula = form1, data = newdata_shrunk )
 
  pred_localS <- mod_newdata_shrink$fitted.values
  return(pred_localS)
  
}
```

Simulation: true model
```{r}
lm_original <- lm(WEI ~ HEI + SYS + AGE + PUL , data = gusto.dat) #TRUE MODEL

mu_i <- lm_original$fitted.values #true values

sigma <- summary(lm_original)$sigma

N_sim <- 100

#Empty matrixes
pred_sim_ols <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(gusto.dat), ncol = N_sim)

pred_sim_ridge <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(gusto.dat), ncol = N_sim)

pred_sim_localS <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(gusto.dat), ncol = N_sim)

fold_k5 <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out= nrow(gusto.dat))) #set the fold partition

```

Data generation
```{r}
y_sim_all <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(gusto.dat), ncol = N_sim)

for (alpha_i in 1:N_sim) { 

  #simulated dataset
  y_sim = mu_i + rnorm(n= nrow(gusto.dat), mean = 0, sd=sigma ) 
  
  newdata <- gusto.dat
  
  y_sim_all[, alpha_i] <- y_sim}

```

for loop Linear Regression
```{r}
#LINEAR REGRESSION
for (alpha_ols in 1:N_sim) { 
  
  newdata <- gusto.dat
  
  newdata$y_sim <- y_sim_all[, alpha_ols]
  
  lm_sim_OLS <- lm(y_sim ~ HEI + SYS + AGE + PUL, data = newdata) #fitted model on newdata
  
  pred_sim_OLS <- lm_sim_OLS$fitted.values 
  
  pred_sim_ols[,alpha_ols] <- pred_sim_OLS}
  
```



for loop Ridge 
```{r}

  #RIDGE
for (alpha_ridge in 1:N_sim) {
  newdata <- gusto.dat

  newdata$y_sim <- y_sim_all[, alpha_ridge]
  
  x = as.matrix(newdata[, c('HEI', 'SYS', 'AGE', 'PUL')]) #predictor matrix
  
  cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(x= x,y= newdata$y_sim, alpha=0,  lambda= c(1, 0.5,0.1,0.05,0.02,0.01, 0),foldid = fold_k5) #cross validation
  
  lambda_i <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
  
  lm_sim_RIDGE <- glmnet(x=x , y= newdata$y_sim , alpha = 0, lambda = lambda_i) #fitted model on newdata, chosen lambda
  
  pred_ridge <- predict(lm_sim_RIDGE, newx = x) #predict per each simulation
  
  pred_sim_ridge[,alpha_ridge] <- as.vector(pred_ridge) }
  
```


for loop local shrinkage:

To load the CSV file that already contains the local shrinkage predictions (previously calculated and saved in the file 'Simulation_Model_1_LocalPredictions.csv'), read this file on the next chunk and skip the following code until the RESULTS section:
```{r}
data_end <- read.csv(
  "Simulation_Model_1_LocalPredictions.csv",
  header = FALSE
)
data_local <- t(data_end)
dim(data_local)
pred_fileLocal <- as.data.frame(data_local)
```


Otherwise you can create the file from scratch and run the code below

creation of a file csv to save the predictions:

from column 1 to 20 
```{r}

#  LOCAL SHRINKAGE
for (alpha_local in 1:20) {
  newdata <- gusto.dat
  newdata$y_sim <- y_sim_all[, alpha_local]
  


 grid_neff <- c(0, 20 ,50, 100)
 
 mse_grid <- sapply(grid_neff, function(n) Cross_val_local_shrik(neff = n, newdata = newdata, fold_k = fold_k5))
  
 outp <- data.frame(neff = grid_neff,MSE = mse_grid)
  
 optimal_neff <- outp[which.min(outp$MSE), "neff" ] 
  
  
  
  shrink_algo <-local_shrik(neff =  optimal_neff, newdata = newdata)
  
  pred_sim_localS[,alpha_local] <- shrink_algo
  
  row <- t(shrink_algo)   
  rownames(row) <- alpha_local  # 'alpha_local' 
  write.table(                  # file creation
    row,
    file = 'test_Model_1.csv',
    sep = ",",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    append = (alpha_local != 1)
  )
  
  
}

```

RESULTS


MSE model 1
```{r}
MSE_OLS <- colMeans(   #OLS
  (pred_sim_ols- mu_i)^2   
)

MSE_RIDGE <- colMeans(  #ridge
  (pred_sim_ridge- mu_i)^2
)

MSE_LOCAL <- colMeans( #local shrinkage
  (pred_fileLocal - mu_i)^2
)
```

Best method per simulated dataset: which is the method achieving the best predictive accuracy per simulated dataset?
```{r}
mse_all <- cbind(OLS = MSE_OLS, Ridge =MSE_RIDGE, Local = MSE_LOCAL)

mse_min <- apply(mse_all, 1, min) #minimum MSE per row

best_method <- apply(mse_all, 1, which.min) #best method

best_method <- colnames(mse_all)[best_method]

results <- data.frame(
  z = 1:100,
  mse_min = mse_min,
  best_method = best_method
)

counts <- table(results$best_method)

ratios <- counts/100   #ratio of best perforing method 

ratios
```

Bias and Variance per subject (across simulation)

```{r}
#average prediction per subject
pred_meanLocal <- rowMeans(pred_fileLocal)
ols_rowmean_sim <- rowMeans(pred_sim_ols)
ridge_rowmean_sim <- rowMeans(pred_sim_ridge)

#compute bias: 
bias_ridge = ridge_rowmean_sim- mu_i
bias_ols=ols_rowmean_sim- mu_i
bias_local= pred_meanLocal- mu_i

median(bias_ridge)
median(bias_ols)
median(bias_local)

#compute variance :
var_ols <- apply(pred_sim_ols, 1, var)
var_ridge<- apply(pred_sim_ridge, 1, var)
var_local <- apply(pred_fileLocal,1  ,var)

median(var_ols)
median(var_ridge)
median(var_local)
```

Visualization of bias: comparison of methods
```{r}
#Bias OLS vs ridge
plot(x= bias_ols, y= bias_ridge, main = "bias:OLS and Ridge - Model 1 ")
abline(a=0, b=1, col= "purple")

#Bias OLS vs local shrinkage
plot(x= bias_ols, y= bias_local, main = "bias: OLS and Local shrinkage - Model 1")
abline(a=0, b=1, col= "purple")

#Bias ridge vs local
plot(x= bias_ridge, y= bias_local, main = "bias:Ridge and Local shrinkage - Model 1")
abline(a=0, b=1, col= "purple")
```

Bias distributions: visualization through boxplots: 
```{r}
df_bias_wide <- data.frame(OLS = bias_ols, Ridge= bias_ridge, Local_Shrinkage=bias_local)


df_bias_long <- pivot_longer( #from wide to long
  df_bias_wide,
  cols = everything(),
  names_to = "method",
  values_to = "bias"
)

ggplot(df_bias_long, aes(x =method , y =bias , fill =method )) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Bias distribution", fill = "Method", title = "Bias per subject - Model 1") +
  theme_bw()


```
